title: Asaf Jahan v. Purwanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Ashok Bhushan and Yogendra Kumar Sangal, JJ.
disposition: Writ disposed; connection application to be considered under Supply Code in six weeks.
headnote: Tenants who had applied and deposited for a new electricity connection, but had not been connected, sought mandamus to compel issue of the connection. The Division Bench did not grant the connection. It disposed of the writ observing that the pending application be considered under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and decided within six weeks of production of a certified copy.
facts: The petitioners, tenants of a house, applied to Purwanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. for an electricity connection and paid deposits, but no connection was released. They filed Writ-C No. 15576 of 2010 in the Allahabad High Court seeking a mandamus to respondent no. 2 to issue the connection. Counsel for the petitioners and for respondent nos. 1 and 2 were heard. The Court recorded that it was for the licensee to consider the application and take appropriate action on it.

holding_units.holding: A writ seeking mandamus to issue an electricity connection is disposed of with a direction that the pending application be considered under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and decided within six weeks of production of a certified copy; the Court does not itself direct grant of the connection.

not_decided.point: Whether the tenant-petitioners were entitled on merits to a new electricity connection
not_decided.note: Left to the licensee to consider under the Supply Code.
